readout_other: GCaMP6f calcium imaging of cultured cortical neurons; spatial-offset pump-probe imaging (SOPPI) of pressure and temperature fields
direction_notes: Candle soot fiber optoacoustic emitter (about 21-fold higher pressure) evoked calcium responses while the carbon nanotube emitter with matched thermal field evoked negligible responses at the same laser setting; authors conclude photoacoustic rather than photothermal effects dominate.

exposures.label: Fiber optoacoustic emitters (candle soot CSFOE and carbon nanotube CNTFOE) on cultured cortical neurons

target.label: GCaMP6f-labeled primary neurons (DIV 10-13) cultured on a glass-bottom dish

device.model: candle soot fiber optoacoustic emitter (CSFOE) and carbon nanotube fiber optoacoustic emitter (CNTFOE)

timing.protocol_description: Optoacoustic transients generated by 3 ns, 1030 nm laser pulses at a 2.5 kHz repetition rate, delivered as 100 ms trains (16.4 uJ/pulse) and 200 ms trains (51.8 mW) with the fiber tip 0 to 150 um from the neurons. Not an ultrasound transducer; acoustic output is single-cycle optoacoustic transients.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The CNTFOEs show a central frequency of 6.99 MHz, while CSFOEs show a central frequency of 18.72 MHz, approximately 3 times higher than that of the CNTFOEs.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: The CSFOE generated a peak-to-peak pressure of 210.34 kPa, while the CNTFOE only generated a peak-to-peak pressure of 15.58 kPa under 3 times higher incident power.

flags.reason: Optoacoustic emitters, not a conventional transducer; central frequencies 18.72 MHz (CSFOE) and 6.99 MHz (CNTFOE) from FFT of hydrophone signals, listed in that order.

Peak-to-peak pressure measured by hydrophone in water about 300 um from the fiber tip, CSFOE first then CNTFOE, at different laser energies (4.08 and 12.29 uJ/pulse); SOPPI field measurements at 100 um are in arbitrary units.
100 ms in the first stimulation experiment and 200 ms in the distance experiment; the quote supports 100 ms (200 ms is in a following sentence).
3 ns is the laser pulse width, not an acoustic pulse duration; left not_reported.
Culture/dish counts not given; N values are neurons per condition (e.g. 20 and 17).
